faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery P400e use?
faqLeft.a: It uses the Ingenium AJ300P, a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, which is part of a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) system.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery P400e engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery P400e?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm the exact engine code before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ300P Discovery P400e engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The Ingenium AJ300P is the engine fitted to the Discovery P400e, and we rebuild it as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery P400e engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery P400e if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery P400e engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery P400e owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
